description: Irducible/minimal profile: starts as a copy of n2-stage-a; every component that survives must have corpus evidence (removal probe) that deleting it breaks a corpus case or the SongCore flow. This file records the surviving set.

demuxer:mp3.reason: removal probe: demuxer removal breaks all mp3 cases (open fails)

demuxer:flac.reason: removal probe: demuxer removal breaks all flac cases (open fails)

decoder:mp3float.reason: removal probe: decoder removal breaks mp3 decode; mp3float chosen over the fixed-point mp3 alias because it is what a full build resolves for AV_CODEC_ID_MP3

decoder:flac.reason: removal probe: decoder removal breaks flac decode

lib:swresample.reason: format conversion + planar->interleaved; bypass experiment in n3-min-noswr
